scoring_justification: The headline quantities come from a full DFT self-consistency loop that the verifier cannot rerun. The agent must report the four numbers; we compare them to the paper-reported gold values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for the four scored quantities
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: band gap 0.26 eV (first page), valence bandwidth 10.7 eV (page 11), zinc-blende charge transfer 0.24 e, rocksalt charge transfer 0.87 e (page 13).
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from the paper, cross-checked with solve.sh hardcoded numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper’s actual reported results

outputs.description: Computed electronic properties: zinc-blende fundamental band gap, valence bandwidth, and charge transfer for both crystal phases.

output_contract.notes: Scoring compares the reported values against reference values with symmetric tolerances; values within tolerance earn full credit, and credit decays for larger deviations. The agent must implement the DFT procedure from scratch using only NumPy/SciPy; no external DFT package is permitted.

steps.description: Compare each field of results.json to the paper’s gold value; missing or out-of-tolerance values receive partial or zero credit.
